en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of the town of Nossen from the east side. In the foreground are fields and a railway or road, with leafless trees suggesting late autumn or winter. Behind them stands a cluster of townhouses and small buildings. On the hill above the town is a large castle-like complex with towers and steep roofs, dominating the skyline. The lower margin has printed red text identifying the view and the publisher.
